label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Bryson backs LIV Golf fight
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau says he’s "giving as much as I can" to help LIV Golf survive despite Saudi PIF stopping funding after this season, supporting its team golf business plan amid bankruptcy talks.

items.headline: PGA Tour urged to toughen courses
items.text: Critics argue the PGA Tour should adopt tougher championship setups like Aronimink with faster greens and thicker roughs, contrasting with easy birdie-fests that lead to extremely low scoring at regular Tour stops.

items.headline: DeChambeau’s PGA Tour return possible
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau’s LIV contract ends after this season, allowing a possible 2027 return to the PGA Tour, whereas Jon Rahm’s longer LIV deal offers fewer exit options amid LIV funding ending.
